format: Jinja2 template with embedded Triton kernel code
description: This file contains a Jinja2 template for generating a Triton-based GPU kernel to perform matrix multiplication, utilizing specific block strategies and offset calculations. It includes parameterized code segments for input loading, computation, and output storage, with control flow to handle zero-sized inputs and variable memory strides.
